responsibility: Defines fixed-buffer whole-number/string conversions for INTEGER and CARDINAL. It declares procedures to parse signed or unsigned decimal text from ARRAY OF CHAR values with a ConvResults status code, and to format whole numbers back into caller-supplied character arrays with possible truncation, providing the non-channel counterpart to WholeIO built on the same conversion semantics.
same_name_distinction: This .def file declares the fixed-buffer string conversion API for whole numbers, with StrToInt/IntToStr and StrToCard/CardToStr; the same-stem .mod file performs those conversions using shared parsing and formatting support.
